 Juvenile girl shot and killed in Arcadia apartment
 By
 Matthew Rodriguez 
 Matthew Rodriguez 
 Digital Producer, CBS Los Angeles 
 Matthew Rodriguez is a digital producer for CBS Los Angeles. He's previously reported for local outlets like the Argonaut and Pasadena Weekly. Matt typically covers breaking news and crime.
 Read Full Bio 
 Matthew Rodriguez 
 Updated on: October 22, 2026 / 6:08 PM PDT 
 / CBS LA
 Add CBS News on Google 
 A juvenile girl was shot and killed inside an apartment in Arcadia Thursday morning. 
 The Arcadia Police Department said the deadly shooting happened at about 11 a.m. Officers said the suspect fled before they arrived at the apartment. 
 The girl was pronounced dead at the scene, according to police. 
 The Pasadena Police Department responded to the 800 block of S. Arroyo Parkway after reports of a man connected to the case suffering a self-inflicted gunshot wound. Officers said the man was taken to a nearby hospital in an unknown condition.
 The Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department's Homicide Bureau took over the investigation into the case. 
 Investigators urged anyone with information on the shooting to contact homicide detectives at (323) 890-5500. Anyone who wishes to remain anonymous can call Crime Stoppers at 1(800) 222-8477 or visit their website,  lacrimestoppers.org.
